audit_scope: matched position/schedule-location optimization and bounded wage-differential mechanism integration
main_conclusion: Matching has been run and supports narrow bounded comparisons, but structural flags do not substitute for exact occupation, role, schedule-location, legal-status, and bargaining-unit validation.

strongest_current_example.mechanism_interpretation: The salary ordinance assigns a higher base hourly rate to the police position; upstream bargaining, scarcity, job-content, and political-priority pathways are not separately identified.

conditional_examples.interpretation: Safety-side authorized maximum is 25 percent higher, but actual pay and enactment remain unconfirmed.
The police Year 1 entry step is 3.67 percent below the code-enforcement rate, showing that direction changes with schedule location and occupational comparator.
The command-rank comparison is limits-only because the Chief was outside the police bargaining unit.
